tweets.text:
A Missouri prosecutor has been stripped of her authority after the state's attorney general accused her of having inappropriate relationships with multiple people tied to criminal cases she was handling - including an illegal immigrant.

Among the allegations: prosecutors say she helped a migrant facing sex crime charges avoid law enforcement by transferring the title of her car to him and failing to disclose his whereabouts.

The attorney general's office also claims she retaliated against an employee who discovered one of the relationships and created a culture of fear and intimidation inside her office.

A judge has temporarily barred her from acting as prosecutor while the case moves forward. The attorney general's office told Fox News Digital that Johnston "is not allowed to take any actions in any official capacity" and, for now, "is no longer Ray County Prosecuting Attorney."
